steps.text: 2:03 P.M. \ Clear
Iron Carrot City Exterior Mining Site, Mineshaft #26

steps.name: Rim Billiton Worker
steps.text: Tough shift, Johnny. Done down there?

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: Phew.

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: I'm buggered. Pull me up.

steps.name: Rim Billiton Worker
steps.text: Er, I'm in all clean clothes...

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: What's your problem, eh? You're going under next, aren'tcha?

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: What did you need me for?

steps.name: Rim Billiton Worker
steps.text: Security inspector's here. Come to ask the state of things down below.

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: What state of things? When's any shift I've led all these years had a slip-up?

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: Send ol' Inspeccy to talk with the next shift leader.

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: I'm having myself a nice bath. If the Security cohort want to wait for me, they can wait patient.

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: ...Oh, there's a surprise.

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: If it isn't our girl. Back from that long trip of yours?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Been an age, you boneheaded oldie.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: And what do you mean, long trip...? I'm doing proper work, you know.

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: Lighten up, now. I know, you're posted over at Babel, doing big things just all the livelong day.

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: Seen plenty of the world these two years, haven'tcha?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Nothing all that scary... tagging along around different places, that's all.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: And I mean, my work didn't even touch on any core details.

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: Hmph. Get a load of you. Finally knowing to come back.

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: Don't know if it was something upstairs or at Babel, but they were getting along just fine, and then suddenly, there they are, over 'cause they say it's over.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Frankly, I haven't got the first clue either.

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: Forget it. Been back home yet?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Already told them I'm sound.

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: When'd you get back?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Three days ago...

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: Hmph. You know, all your pals in Sec from before got promoted, and here you are now dancing back under their fingers.

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: Why so eager for the job here? Everything with Babel all sorted, then?

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: I'd guess the world's on your shoulders, looking like that.

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: Not here to play 20 Questions on ya, just say what I wanted and be done.

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: But it's a hard thing to do, getting back home to see your old mates. Still not happy?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: I don't... know, myself.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Of course I missed you all, and I mean, I know my hometown mines like nothing else.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: But...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: I just feel—things wrapped up too fast.

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: (Whistle) Look at you. Who says you didn't land a good assignment?

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: Or was it some sweetheart you found that you just can't bear to leave?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Wh—What sweetheart—just a friend, okay!

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Ugh... besides, I didn't do anything praiseworthy either.

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: No, I heard you picked up a big job. Digging those 'goods' out one after another's cost two years of our time.

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: All the workers reckon it has to be something happened outside.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Lots of engineering going on. But I'm only on the bog-standard stuff.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Cooperation this time was to make sure the 'goods' going from Rim Billiton to Babel had a safe journey and made it without hassle. They needed a security crew to see it through.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: And just like that, the hull and core our mining firm dug up gets sent straight to Babel.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: I had some security work to do with them. That's it.

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: So you're saying you really don't know a damn thing?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: (Bitter chuckle) John, you know me, don't you...

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: Old girl... *sigh* Still same as ever, then, making a complete mess of it when the moment comes.

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: Not complaining, though. Let the Sarkaz sort out their own biz! Maybe it's a good thing they muddled it up when it mattered.

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: But if Babel wasn't there to rope you in, would you have any other reason?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: I used to be so sure, you know, I'd live my whole life in the mines.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Didn't need to mind what happens outside. Could say I knew nothing about it.

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: That was your chance to take a gander out there, wasn't it? When you left Rim Billiton.

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: I still remember, when you were just off, you were howling how you didn't wanna go. That's the thing, youngsters, y'know...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Ha, haha...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Johnny, I... got to know a kid like me.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: You know how hard it is, with the Sarkaz life all around you, trying to grow up healthy.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: But she chose to take it on. She learned to endure, to persevere, and kept hope in her heart all along.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: So much more she still needs to know and learn. She was always wrapped around me, asking me all sorts of questions.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: She likes the food I make, and she's especially interested in Rim Billiton's fables.

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: A little rabbit. Where'd she come from?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Rim Billiton. But... she isn't gonna come back. So...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Honestly, I don't know either, why it is I'm worrying so much.

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: Hmph, now isn't that easy—

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: You want to protect her.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: I do. I do wanna protect her.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: But now's not the time. I've got no reason to stay there, and none of the skill to guide her forward.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: I knew. I should come back to Rim Billiton, is what I should do.

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: Seems like you've already found your calling, then, haven'tcha?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: It's not all that big a thing. After all, if I insisted on staying at Babel, other people wouldn't wanna hire me, and then I'd be out of a job, poor me! Haha...

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: You utter case, you...

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: Forget it, just do what you've gotta do now!

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: Keeping us safe in the mines is all up to you Security lot.

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: Especially you. Seeing you'll give your mates plenty peace of mind.

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: At least for now, we need you.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Right. I understand.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Odd of you, Johnny. Got a lot to say today, ain'tcha?

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: Hmph, you're a special case. You've seen the world out there, now. Can't go around putting on airs anymore.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Haha, don't joke like that—

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: So?

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: Can't have forgotten our traditional Cautus virtues, coming all the way back from out yonder?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Huh? What virtues?

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: You little girlie... prezzies, of course it's prezzies, to mark the occasion!

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: I've got no basis to leave Rim Billiton, no way to go out and see the sights. You youngsters, forgetting all about me the moment the chance for it lands in your lap...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Haha, I'm having you on. How could I forget?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: I didn't know if I'd have another chance to leave after I came back, so I made sure to buy whole trunks of stuff, and brought it back myself.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Here. A top-of-the-line hearing aid I picked up in Victoria, just for you.

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: Now that's more like it. All those shifts I had with you paid off.

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: I'll be able to pick out what the kids are saying so much easier with this. Urgh, ruddy condition. Ruddy job.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Alright, alright. I'll head down to inspect, then.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Hah, there's a familiar feeling.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Protective clothing so stuffy you choke, stiff and heavy worker's cap, can't wipe off your sweat even if you wanted to.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Mining away in tough conditions like these, risking your life with Originium for company.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: My people's lives, all spent upon these mines going dirtier and deeper.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: —This used to be my whole life, my everything. Just like the rest of us.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Is this how I'm gonna spend my future, same as the past?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Stoppit, stoppit, there's no point thinking so hard. I have to work properly, at the least... The safety, the lives of workers like Johnny are on my back, now.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: But... I just can't help wondering...

a.text: Will you get used to life without one of your kind by your side?
Can you grow big without someone making you good food from home?
Once I'm back in Rim Billiton, I'll have no chance to reach you anymore.
The Doctor, Kal'tsit, they'll take good care of you, won't they?
With them, you'll get stronger, have a mission you can call your own.
I... have responsibilities, right now, that still need me.
But when there's a day you need me too, I'll come to your aid, no doubt about it.
If we really do face the same way in our steps, we'll meet again.

steps.text: Two years later
1:34 P.M. \ Blistering heat
Iron Carrot City Exterior Mining Site, Mineshafts #27, #28, #29

steps.name: Rim Billiton Worker
steps.text: Out—Get out!

steps.name: Rim Billiton Worker
steps.text: The dust's about to explode—

steps.name: Rim Billiton Worker
steps.text: Ugh—gaah—!

steps.name: Rim Billiton Worker
steps.text: Save m—*cough*, *cough*—

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: Calm down! All of you, oxygen tanks on!

steps.name: Rim Billiton Worker
steps.text: Help—save me, for—

steps.name: Rim Billiton Security Chief
steps.text: What's the alarm sounding for?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: It's a serious danger alert... something's happened in the mines!

steps.name: Rim Billiton Security Chief
steps.text: Report!

steps.name: Rim Billiton Worker
steps.text: I-It's gone to hell, Mineshafts #27, #28, #29 have all had active Originium dust explosions!

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: What?

steps.name: Rim Billiton Security Chief
steps.text: Tch...! I SAID we couldn't start work in this bloody weather!

steps.name: Rim Billiton Security Chief
steps.text: Bloody anything for that bit of output—

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Shaft #29... that's...!

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Any casualties among personnel? What's the state of the site?

steps.name: Rim Billiton Security Chief
steps.text: There—There are workers buried in the collapse! Confirmed, there are wounded!

steps.name: Rim Billiton Security Chief
steps.text: Strewth! Savage!

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Understood!

steps.name: Rim Billiton Security Chief
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Rim Billiton Security Chief
steps.text: Get rescuing. I'll lock down the accident site.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: —Get your protective gear on, and follow me!

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Haah, haah...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Dig, dig... gotcha!

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Are you still alive, oldie, are you still there?!

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: —Johnny!

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Hold on! Grab my hand!

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: *cough*...!

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: Hurts... like hell...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Hang in there, Johnny, we can get you!

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Pull him out, quick!

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Stay with me, Johnny! No sleeping now!

steps.name: Rim Billiton Worker
steps.text: Savage, we're 300m from the medic tent!

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Rush him!

steps.name: Rim Billiton Worker
steps.text: Got it!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Medic Operator
steps.text: Hello, we're the joint emergency medical group assigned to this mining incident.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Rim Billiton PLC Security Group, haah, haah... wounded...!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Medic Operator
steps.text: Understood. We'll find a bed for them immediately.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Medic Operator
steps.text: Could you register some information with us for now? We need to contact next of kin immediately...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: The company will sort that out straight away! Just start treating him first!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Medic Operator
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Thomas, you stay behind to register and get set up with the branch.

steps.name: Rim Billiton Worker
steps.text: Got it!

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Everyone else, with me! There's still wounded we haven't rescued.

steps.name: Rim Billiton Worker
steps.text: Got it!

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Right, you're...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Medic Operator
steps.text: My coworkers and I form a volunteer emergency aid group for this incident. We're from Rhodes Island Pharmaceuticals Inc.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: (Rhodes Island? I haven't heard of that company...)

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Alright, Rhodes Island. I'll... leave the oldie to you, then.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Please, you have to save him.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Medic Operator
steps.text: We'll do what we can.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Ngh... quick, let's get the next one out!

steps.name: Rim Billiton Security Chief
steps.text: Good work, Savage.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: All accounted for?

steps.name: Rim Billiton Security Chief
steps.text: Hardly believe it. We even found all the bodies. Twelve wounded, three critically, and the dead...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: That's enough.

steps.name: Rim Billiton Security Chief
steps.text: Even if I didn't tell, nobody'd know it better than you.

steps.name: Rim Billiton Security Chief
steps.text: Judging by the concentration of Originium dust at the scene, the injured are all in big trouble...

steps.name: Rim Billiton Security Chief
steps.text: Where are you going?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Aid post. I'm going to see the old man.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Right. There were a few medics out of the aid volunteers who came from 'Rhodes Island.' You heard of that organization before, chief?

steps.name: Rim Billiton Security Chief
steps.text: Rhodes Island...? Doesn't ring a bell. Bet it's a fresh new company.

steps.name: Rim Billiton Security Chief
steps.text: Get going. Good chance to inspect while you're there. See what this Rhodes Island is here for.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Medic Operator
steps.text: Hello, can I ask who you...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Medic Operator
steps.text: Ah, you're the one from the Security team! You carried the first of the wounded over, too.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Just call me Savage. I'm here to see how they're doing.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: One of the casualties just now... should be registered as 'John.'

steps.name: Rhodes Island Medic Operator
steps.text: Mister John, is it? Please be assured, our Medic Operators have already administered emergency treatment to him.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Is... How are his injuries?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Medic Operator
steps.text: Right. Originium crystals penetrated to his arm and the flank of his abdomen. This ruptured his protective gear, and the amount of Originium particulate he inhaled afterwards also...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: So, he's already been infected for sure, hasn't he?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Medic Operator
steps.text: Y... Yes.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Damn it. Too slow.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Medic Operator
steps.text: However, we've made use of Rhodes Island injective medication in the treatment already given to Mister John, and that's prevented any further progression of infection.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: What...? But, with injuries that bad, and wounds directly from active Originium crystals...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Medic Operator
steps.text: I do understand your concern, Miss.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Just... call me Savage. You said your drug injection stopped the spread? Is that true?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Medic Operator
steps.text: Yes, Miss Savage. All the personnel carried in so far have been administered emergency medication in accordance with their level of injury and severity of infection.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Medic Operator
steps.text: Some patients are not out of danger yet due to their overly severe blood loss, but their Originium infection symptoms have been fundamentally suppressed.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: All suppressed?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Medic Operator
steps.text: Yes, every one... Do you have any issues?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: No. Thing is, even if the drug works some wonders, it's not something you can give to workers straight away.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Rim Billiton's extant medical orgs all use cheap Originium infection meds, and they only do so little for workers who're already infected.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: But then Rhodes Island...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: You're a volunteer aid group, aren'tcha? These emergency meds aren't cheap, and the doses are pretty staggering. You all...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Medic Operator
steps.text: Er, I—I'm not responsible for any of that at all...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Medic Operator
steps.text: But, I can promise you, Mister John's already out of mortal danger. He'll be able to receive visitors before long.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: It's not the same... Once they're Infected, workers' fates are already sealed.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: They're forced into even cheaper labor, sent to the exhausted mineshafts for all the most brutal, dangerous work, collecting remainders.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Medic Operator
steps.text: I'm sorry. When they arrived, most of the patients had already...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: No, I should be the one apologizing here. I'm sorry, you've already done so much and then some... thank you, a million times.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Medic Operator
steps.text: Miss Savage, I... I understand your feelings.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Medic Operator
steps.text: Director Kal'tsit once instructed us that no matter how many wounds we heal, how much Oripathy we suppress...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Medic Operator
steps.text: Once you've become Infected, no matter how unreasonable it is, most of society has already turned against you.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: That's right. Kal'tsit told you some...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Who did you—just say your director was?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Medic Operator
steps.text: Kal'tsit. She's an example to all our Medic Operators at Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Director... Kal'tsit...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Don't tell me...!

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Who—Who's your leader? At Rhodes Island—What's the name of your leader at this Rhodes Island place?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Medic Operator
steps.text: She's, um...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Tell me. Please, I need to know.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Medic Operator
steps.text: She's called...

steps.name: Rhodes Island Medic Operator
steps.text: Our leader's, Rhodes Island's current leader's name is—

steps.name: Rhodes Island Medic Operator
steps.text: 'Amiya.'

steps.name: Rhodes Island Medic Operator
steps.text: Excuse me, is there a problem?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: How is it Amiya...? If it really is her, she shouldn't be much older right now than—

steps.name: Rhodes Island Medic Operator
steps.text: Mm-hm, yes, our leader is considerably young.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Medic Operator
steps.text: But... you'll know once you talk to her, even once. She has wisdom beyond her years and a strong will. She's a truly outstanding leader.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Medic Operator
steps.text: Miss Savage, might you know some... Are you an old acquaintance of Amiya's, possibly?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Ah... um, we... were good friends since long ago.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Can you... Can you get in contact with Amiya? Just say my name, and she'll know.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Medic Operator
steps.text: I see. Amiya did mention she had a very close friend who might be here in Rim Billiton now...

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: It... It really is Amiya... Can I go see her? How?

steps.name: Rhodes Island Medic Operator
steps.text: I'll get in touch with Rhodes Island's Messengers now. Also, Miss Savage, if you have anything you'd like us to relay to her...

a.text: In this two-year span of time, Savage has been completely on her own, not once departing her post at that Rim Billiton mine.
She's bewildered. She's lost in thought.
She once thought, maybe, she should spend the rest of her life sound in Rim Billiton.
But rousing Savage's fighting spirit, her resolve, was as easy as this.
It took just an instant—the one instant she heard, from someone else's mouth, the name of who she'd once cared for, been with day and night.
Savage already understands just what sort of decision she's going to make.

steps.text: Fifteen days later
Iron Carrot City Outskirts, Aid Station, in the Infected Ward

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: The moment I realized I was Infected, I even thought, maybe my family would've been much better off if I'd just carked it and they got the compensation money.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Don't say that.

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: Just a thought I had... *sigh*.

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: The very first thing that came to mind, d'ya know, was I asked myself, how the hell should I face my family now?

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: My better half and the kids don't like it when I'm angry, and they hate it even more when they see me cry.

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: But when it's time to meet them, am I really gonna be able to smile?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: This is nothing like you, you oldie.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Everyone knows you as the most hopeful guy for miles around.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: When even you're seeing family with your ears drooped down, how're the rest of your mates meant to meet anyone?

steps.name: Rim Billiton Worker
steps.text: Yeah, you're right!

steps.name: Rim Billiton Worker
steps.text: You're gonna spoil all our moods like that acting miserable, Johnny!

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: Hmph. You don't have a bunch of tykes to feed. You don't know the pain of it. Life's a bastard one.

steps.name: Rim Billiton Worker
steps.text: We're all gonna have some bloody awful days too—

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: Hey, Savage. Don't listen to another word from them.

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: I've already decided. Pay'll be nowhere near enough to feed my family if I keep working at Rim Billiton.

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: Once the sickness lifts a little, we'll be off to Columbia, simple as that. All of us are heading to be part of the 'Great Expansion.'

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: John... you're really about to leave?

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: When I was a miner for Rim Billiton, I was the most diligent, hardworking worker, bar none.

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: Now, I'm an Infected, and no matter how long I've still got left, I have to keep everyone at home living safely. Living happily.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Has it ever come to mind, so long as Rim Billiton's not done digging by the end of the day, this back-and-forth life's just gonna...

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: Savage.

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: Every person, every age, has callings and responsibilities to answer.

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: I've never once been ashamed of being a mineworker. Nobody in Rim Billiton'd ever think that.

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: But, you see, Savage, you left Rim Billiton, been back two years, and your thinking changed.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Yeah...

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: I knew you'd be no ordinary rabbit, ever since you were a nipper. Every last person has their own calling, and their own responsibilities.

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: Your hammer's saved our lives. In the days to come, you'll be saving countless more.

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: If there's someone you need to protect, then leave, eh. It's the same for me.

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: Heh, peek at the face you're making. Looks like you made your mind up long ago, didn'tcha?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Hey, I'm not some emotionless robot, you oldie.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: It's just, this is something I've gotta go do.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: I have a friend I need to protect.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Finally... I've found her again. I can see her again.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Even if it's just the slightest thing, for her, I'll give every last bit of strength I have.

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: Hmph. There's nothing out there worth giving 'every last bit.' That's just you youngsters being too naive.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Haha... I mean, going into the mines for your family, and coming back out now for them, you said that, didn'tcha? You're using all your strength, giving it all you have too, right?

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: Who says I'm like you? I'm trying to feed a family here!

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Alright, alright.

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: Hmph...

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: When're you looking to head out?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Today. Came to see you for the last time, and then I'll be setting off.

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: It's been by your help we didn't have one accident these past two years.

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: And this one, well, it was you again who pulled us out alive... can't thank you enough.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Well, you've got me put on a pedestal.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: John, you need to cherish the life I saved, and make sure you live the coming days well, alright?

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: You rotten little girl.

steps.name: Johnny
steps.text: See you.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: See you too. Johnny.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: (It'll be goodbye for now, Rim Billiton.)

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Sorry, I've been keeping you.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Medic Operator
steps.text: Miss Savage, are you already done with all your goodbyes?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Seriously, John... told me right at the end, I should head back home again and give them a proper farewell.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Yesterday when I said goodbye to my mum and dad, my mum was going on about 'next time you come back, you'll have a special someone.'

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: This is for my career here!

steps.name: Rhodes Island Medic Operator
steps.text: Hah, haha.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Medic Operator
steps.text: All of you are such a happy group.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Medic Operator
steps.text: I've linked up with the landship, and the expedited onboard application's all gone through. These papers are a recruitment contract from HR.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Medic Operator
steps.text: Detailed work matters should be handed over once we reach the landship, Miss Savage. Rhodes Island very much welcomes your arrival.

steps.name: Rhodes Island Medic Operator
steps.text: Well then... Miss Savage, have a good journey.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Finally, finally.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: I've found it.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Amiya, what are you like now?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: You've already grown into a leader. That's incredible.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Wait for me, Amiya. No matter what happens, no matter what calling you're shouldering.

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: I've got a lot I want to tell you, a lot of stories I want to share. Will you want to hear them?

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: All the good and the bad that you've been through, all the good and the bad I've been through, in all these two years—

steps.name: Savage
steps.text: Once we meet, let's tell each other all we want.
